state.objective: Can targets AI coding agents. Correct behavior, reliable edits, explicit contracts and independent composition lead; total tokens per successful task including context, diagnostics and retries is secondary. Human familiarity and source brevity are not goals. There are zero external users and no compatibility obligation. Prefer equivalent native JavaScript/Bun operations with only adapters needed for contracts and immutability. Select informative bounded technical trials, never syntax or final language adoption.
state.provenance: Evidence packets inspect revision 02a549d2. Historical executed probes at 4c2db1e have unchanged compiler/runtime sources at that revision. Current focused type, project and resolver tests pass; assertion runtime tests passed 14/14. These are source audits and narrow tests, not candidate implementations or agent comparisons. Existing decisions remain authoritative. Pattern-intent and finite-generic-error experiments were consulted separately and are excluded here. No general effect system, arbitrary backend access or mutable aliases is justified.
state.values: DI-02: Exported records share one visibility bit for type and construction, allow positional creation, public projection and same-type with updates, and are frozen. A private record cannot appear in a public signature. Generic decoding projects declared fields directly into nominal records without calling a source factory. Thus a transparent email(str value) can be forged through construction, update or structural decode; this is source/runtime inference, not a dedicated exported-email execution. The strongest baseline decodes a public wire record, calls a validator, and revalidates at ingress and sensitive operations; correct application behavior is possible, but nominal membership cannot certify validation. Owner boundaries must cover equality, hidden-field matching, with, encoding/decoding/schema and fixture completions together. Test email canonicalization, positive quantity and tenant identifiers; valid tenant identity never grants access to another tenant's invoice. Owner-controlled designs still trust their author's creation code; central validators need recursion, normalization, side-effect and finite-failure rules.
state.packages: DI-05a: Internal graph IDs already include project/dependency identity and short package name; output paths hash that identity. Graph.Packages nevertheless indexes all loaded packages by short name and rejects duplicates before uses aliases run. File-local aliases cannot fix two independent dependencies both declaring model. Imports resolve only declared direct dependencies and enforce canonical internal visibility and reserved catalogue names. Compare consuming both unchanged libraries in one root file, then renaming root aliases, adding a transitive model and relocating the checkout. Dependency imports must resolve through that dependency's own table; distinct loaded versions/instances cannot merge merely because names match. Keep source maps, lock reproducibility and emitted native module identity coherent. Globally qualified authored declarations are a coherent future regime but require rewriting bare-name libraries, so cannot pass the unchanged-library case.
state.errors: DI-05b: Nominal errors are identified by declaring package/declaration and concrete generic arguments, whereas source numeric IDs are diagnostic codes. Source numbers duplicate active can.errors.json entries, locks snapshot registries, and active plus retired codes must be globally unique across catalogue/root/dependencies. Loader, checker and runtime failure-plan admission all enforce numeric uniqueness. The audited code identifies those consumers but establishes no external numeric-report or cross-release rename requirements. Scoped codes, build-local allocation and textual keys all need coherent registry/lock/plan/report treatment. Two libraries reusing active codes or another library's retired code should compose without coordination under a new contract. Test both failures, two generic instances, and reports across a dependency-addition build; a shared declaration code must not merge specialized nominal errors. A hash alone is not a collision-free numeric scheme. Package owner identity is a dependency of this choice, but no package candidate is assumed selected.
state.fixtures: DI-06: Attached assertions have full package/declaration/name roots. Lexical when rows select by the running root's short name; FIFO queues isolate full root/table/invocation paths and never search arguments to allocate occurrences. Historical execution renamed only caller customer to renamed: static checking passed, helper fixture activation disappeared, text::from_int(7) returned 7 rather than fixture text, and the helper's own unit assertion still passed. This is a fragile selector relationship, not a concurrent queue collision. Inert exact-target templates expand under a use-site selector and retain that fragility. Whole-helper stubs plus separate helper unit assertions avoid internal linking but lose integrated helper-body coverage; ordinary injected callables are another current API baseline. Every candidate retains attached roots, exact target/arguments, lexical queues, FIFO, recursion/callable/participant paths and distinct real/supplied/raw-provider evidence labels. Compare root rename, duplicate root labels, two helper invocations, recursion, concurrent participants, missing links and unused fixtures; a deliberately requested missing scenario must not silently run real code.
state.variants: DI-07: Current assignment first rejects different specializations of the same generic variant, including phantom parameters, then otherwise uses nominal leaf-set inclusion. Historical direct tagged<int> -> tagged<str> fails; tagged<int> -> bridge -> tagged<str> and narrowing through shared unit succeed. Current focused type tests confirm the rule; no runtime identity or memory defect is demonstrated. Variants are flattened sets without constructors/wrappers; values and codec tags are nominal leaves. Generic records have distinct specialized nominal identities and are not shown broken. Compare direct/bridge/unit paths, nested variants, leaf addition, option<int>/option<str>, shared none, distinct some<int>/some<str>, generic record leaves and codec roundtrips. Extensional variants cannot provide brands; existing nominal record wrapping is a baseline for brands. Wrappers would change representation, conversions, matching and wire identity, so measure allocations and codec consequences. No comparative agent cost exists.
state.trial_policy: Judge only technical information gained relative to implementation scope. Each candidate is a possible experiment, with the best current idiom as a control; none is already proven beneficial. Include creation, held-out rename/refactor and diagnostic repair cases with equivalent agent context/tools and preregistered model/effort/trials. Require contract tests and reproducible failure or measured benefit after library/tooling alternatives. If evidence cannot distinguish next trials, select defer_measure rather than fabricate certainty. All five questions are independent against this shared state.

validated_value_trial.instructions: For DI-02, which next bounded comparison most usefully tests an unforgeable package-owned validated-value contract across every creation path, given the strongest baseline and remaining evidence gaps? Select a trial, not syntax or adoption.

criteria.owner_record: Test a public nominal record with package-only construction and with updates. Permit selected immutable projections and identity matching without hidden-field destructuring. Owner functions validate minting; equality is owner-defined unless deliberately exposed. Reject derived decode/schema and use wire records plus owner factories; encode via owner projection. Fixtures use factories or validated owner constants. Keep frozen JS records with compiler visibility checks; cost is trust in owner code and additional adapters.
criteria.opaque_value: Trial an entirely hidden authored nominal representation, with owner wrap/unwrap, observation, equality and update APIs; consumers may test leaf identity in variants but cannot destructure or with-update. Owner codecs use separate wire types; derived codec/schema is forbidden. Assertions observe projections/equality and obtain genuine owner values. A frozen brand wrapper is used unless erasure is proven safe. Smaller legal surface trades against accessors, fixture work and possible allocations.
criteria.checked_construction: Prototype one owner validator over raw representation with finite errors, invoked for every constructor, with update, decode and supplied fixture. It validates/canonicalizes without recursively minting the target. Fields and nominal patterns stay public, equality compares validated fields. Decode combines structural and domain failures; schema promises only shape. Define recursion/effects and lower to validator calls plus frozen records. This centralizes admission but makes construction and codecs fallible.
criteria.defer_measure: First execute the missing exported-email importer/decoder/fixture counterexamples and benchmark explicit wire-record factories plus operation revalidation, making no boundary prototype yet; this baseline promises correct operations, not valid nominal membership.

package_identity_trial.instructions: For DI-05a, which resolution-contract experiment is most useful for composing independent packages without editing them while preserving identity and confinement? Treat declaration-qualified rewriting as a different prerequisite, not a pass for unchanged libraries.

criteria.qualified_imports: Prototype source imports naming a direct dependency key and package with optional local aliases. Local packages use the current project, catalogue a reserved namespace, and dependency internals their own tables. Preserve distinct instances, locks and identity-based native imports. This puts selection in source but adds qualified references.
criteria.manifest_handles: Prototype unique project-manifest handles mapped to direct dependency/package targets, optionally file-aliased in source. Each dependency owns its mappings, catalogue handles cannot be shadowed, and missing/ambiguous entries diagnose. Locks bind resolved identities rather than handle names; native imports are static. This centralizes remapping but adds a consulted file.
criteria.qualified_declarations: Trial globally author/project-qualified package declarations and local aliases after rewriting bare-name libraries. Distinct loaded instances remain separate; identical declared identities require an explicit resolution choice. No unchanged-library success is claimed. Compare reduced map indirection against author naming coordination and migration work.
criteria.defer_measure: Gather the full two-dependency graph, alias/relocation/lock counterexamples and comparative agent tasks first, retaining the global-short-name baseline as a documented failing control rather than choosing a new lookup prototype.

error_identity_trial.instructions: For DI-05b, which next reporting-identity trial most informatively removes independent allocation collisions without inventing unverified external stability requirements? Include numeric consumer and rename-policy uncertainty in the decision.

criteria.scoped_numbers: Trial owner-scoped authored numbers and active/retired registries. Reports carry canonical owner plus local number; retirement blocks only owner-local reuse. Locks and all loader/checker/plan/report consumers use that pair, while nominal matching still includes declaration and generic arguments. Native maps/metadata suffice; source bookkeeping remains and naked integers become insufficient.
criteria.build_numbers: Trial canonical source declaration keys with deterministic unique compact numbers allocated from the full locked graph and an archived reverse map/build identity in every report. Numbers may change after graph growth; specializations share a declaration number but retain arguments. Tombstone retired declaration keys. Migrate source/registry numbering, audit every consumer and compare map dependence against removed manual allocation.
criteria.text_keys: Trial reporting canonical qualified declaration strings and concrete arguments directly. Optional compact numbers are build-local mapped metadata only if consumers need them; retirement and rename/reuse policy live in owner metadata. Migrate source/registry and all report consumers. Native strings suffice, avoiding mandatory reverse-map lookup at the cost of longer reports and explicit key evolution.
criteria.defer_measure: Finish identifying numeric/report consumers and cross-release rename requirements, then run duplicate/retired-ID and two-build report cases before choosing among the three schemes. Keep globally coordinated IDs as a failing composition baseline, without treating absent external users as proof no report contract matters.

fixture_ownership_trial.instructions: For DI-06, which bounded ownership experiment best tests deliberate cross-package fixture activation without sacrificing checked invocation/queue guarantees? Compare coverage honestly with templates, whole-helper stubs and ordinary injected callables.

criteria.lexical_only: Trial selecting lexical fixtures only from their declared test scope, removing foreign short-label activation. Callers use whole-helper stubs; helper roots test internals and integration runs real bodies or ordinary injected APIs. Templates only reuse inert content. Existing contexts enforce scope without new links; cross-package simulated body coverage is deliberately absent, not claimed equivalent.
criteria.exported_scenarios: Trial helper-exported named configurations of its lexical fixtures. A caller explicitly links a particular helper invocation site to declaration/scenario identity; nested calls declare links too. Route recursion/participants through isolated invocation paths. Missing, inaccessible, ambiguous, unused or incompatible links diagnose. Compile plan entries into current contexts/queues, hiding helper internals at the cost of a published scenario API.
criteria.exported_seams: Trial helper-approved typed symbolic seams at lexical calls. Caller roots bind fixture content along checked call paths; helper owns seam targets/signatures and caller owns behavior. Invocation identity isolates recursive/participant FIFO queues. Missing requested seams, unused required bindings and changed signatures fail. Compile bounded declared paths to existing contexts; precise control exposes more internal structure and refactor work.
criteria.defer_measure: First benchmark lexical templates, whole-helper stubs plus separate helper assertions, and normal callable injection on the renamed-root integrated task. Preserve their explicit coverage limits and current failure evidence, but delay any fixture ownership prototype pending measured comparison.

variant_policy_trial.instructions: For DI-07, which assignment-policy trial most usefully resolves the direct/bridge/leaf inconsistency while preserving nominal records, option behavior and honest codec guarantees? Choose a semantic experiment, not a brand requirement or syntax preference.

criteria.extensional_leaves: Trial one inclusion relation over fully specialized nominal leaf sets, removing the same-declaration specialization veto. Equal phantom leaf sets admit direct/bridge/unit paths; names add no brand. some<int> and some<str> remain distinct record leaves and none is shared. Matching and codecs retain flattened leaf behavior with native tag tests. Compare agent predictions and negative nominal-record cases against today's rule.
criteria.document_current: Trial better diagnostics and exact documentation of the current two-stage rule: reject differing instances of one generic variant, otherwise admit leaf subsets. Bridge/unit conversions remain legal, no provenance or durable brand is claimed, and matching/codecs stay flat. Measure whether agents can handle immediate-static-type-sensitive edits without changing semantics.
criteria.nominal_wrappers: Trial distinct nominal wrapper identity for every variant/specialization, explicit leaf injection and controlled unwrapping in matches. Cross-variant movement requires exhaustive mapping/reinjection, so implicit direct/bridge/leaf escapes fail; a deliberately exported leaf may be explicitly reinjected. Use frozen branded JS wrappers unless safe erasure is proven. Codecs encode or contextually restore exact wrapper identity. Measure allocations, adapters and agent edits against existing nominal record wrappers.
criteria.defer_measure: Run the full current option/generic-record/codec/direct-bridge-leaf matrix and controlled agent refactors first, retaining today's semantics without asserting a brand. Defer a policy prototype until these broader effects and costs have executable evidence.
